task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Production' window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The iDempiere window title or tab shows 'Production' or 'Production (Single)'.

task_completion.description: Select 'Patio Set' as the product to be produced.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Product' field in the Production header contains 'Patio Set'.
The 'Production Quantity' or 'Movement Quantity' field in the header shows '5'.

task_completion.description: Set the movement date to today's date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Movement Date' field is populated with the current date.

task_completion.description: Ensure the production plan includes 20 'Patio Chair' and 5 'Patio Table' components.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Production Line tab or component list, 'Patio Chair' shows a quantity of 20 (or -20) and 'Patio Table' shows a quantity of 5 (or -5).

task_completion.description: Process or complete the production run to update inventory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'DocAction' button is clicked, and the 'Document Status' changes to 'Completed' or 'Closed'.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or selected the specific quantities and products required.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Patio Set', '20', and '5' values appear in the appropriate UI fields within the iDempiere application.

integrity.description: The agent did not use a terminal or command line to execute SQL scripts to bypass the UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target product is 'Patio Set'. The required quantity is 5. The Bill of Materials (BOM) for this task requires 4 'Patio Chair' and 1 'Patio Table' per set, totaling 20 'Patio Chair' and 5 'Patio Table' for the run. The task is successful only if the document status reaches 'Completed' within the iDempiere Production window.
